title: Fresh Trade and the Card Processing Rate Passed Through on a Micro Market Settlement
content:
Where a market format in the Unattended Micro Market Program carries a frozen unit, the share of the quarter's kiosk trips taken at the fresh cabinet can move the card processing rate passed through on the settlement.

## The clause

1. Where the fresh cabinet took at or above 33 per cent of the kiosk trips over the three months to the day the settlement is raised, and the market format carries a frozen unit, the card processing rate printed against the market format is raised by the card uplift step of 0.25 percentage points.
2. Where the fresh cabinet took below 33 per cent of the kiosk trips over those three months, and the market format carries a frozen unit, the card processing rate printed against the market format is lowered by the card relief step of 0.2 percentage points.
3. Where the market format carries no frozen unit, no such change to the rate is made.

## Reading the fresh share

The fresh share floor is 33 per cent of the kiosk trips posted over the three months to the day the settlement is raised. Fresh cabinet trips standing at exactly 33 per cent of the quarter's trips are at or above the floor; 32 per cent is below it.

| Fresh cabinet share of the quarter's kiosk trips | Frozen unit in the format | Judgement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 33 per cent or more | carried | the printed rate is raised by 0.25 percentage points |
| below 33 per cent | carried | the printed rate is lowered by 0.2 percentage points |
| any | not carried | no such change to the rate is made |

*Hypothetical.* A quarter of 60 kiosk trips of which 22 were taken at the fresh cabinet stands at a fresh share above 33 per cent; on a format carrying a frozen unit and printing a card processing rate of 2.6 per cent, the rate passed through is 2.85 per cent. Had only 12 of those 60 trips been fresh, the rate passed through would be 2.4 per cent.
